company.name: SiFi Networks (ArcLink Fiber)
company.description: SiFi Networks (ArcLink Fiber) is the continuing U.S. open-access fiber platform using the SiFi Networks and FiberCity brands. On August 7, 2026, ArcLink Fiber LLC acquired substantially all operating assets, contracts and goodwill of SiFi Networks America, LLC after bankruptcy-court approval, while excluded assets and the investor-owned City LLC project companies remained outside the acquired package. ArcLink Fiber (US) Limited controls sifinetworks.com and sits within the Smart City Infrastructure Fund structure. APG Asset Management and PATRIZIA remain supported manager affiliations through the current SCIF and buyer-affiliate chain, but their post-restructuring economic percentages and ArcLink Fiber LLC's exact membership are not publicly disclosed. APG's announced 16.7% SiFi interest is retained only as a historical 2021 fact and is not treated as a current stake.
company.headquarters: California; Michigan; Florida; Wisconsin; multi-city U.S. operations

milestones.event: ArcLink Fiber LLC acquired substantially all operating assets, contracts and goodwill of SiFi Networks America, LLC after the bankruptcy court entered the sale order on August 6; excluded assets and the investor-owned City LLC project companies remained outside the acquired package.
Future Fiber, APG, and SiFi raised $350 million of seven-year financing for U.S. FTTH deployment.
APG signed an agreement to acquire a 16.7% direct stake in SiFi Networks America and establish a U.S. fiber joint venture.
SiFi announced Smart City Infrastructure Fund support for FiberCity growth.
The Smart City Infrastructure Fund and Whitehelm Capital backed SiFi's Fullerton FiberCity deployment.
Ubuntu Business Holdings invested in SiFi Networks America Limited through Prior SiFi Networks America ownership.
